dimensions.description: meme-id: meme_file_name; hasOverallIntent: overall-intent_id; overall-intent-description: The image features a photograph of Maxine Waters, a Black U.S. politician, speaking at a podium with an American flag in the background. The overlaid text quotes her saying, 'if you see anybody from trump's cabinet in a restaurant, in a department store, at a gasoline station... you create a crowd and push back and tell them they're not welcome anywhere.' The meme is dated June 24, 2018. The overall intent is to present her statement as a call to action against members of Donald Trump's administration, using her authoritative image to lend weight to the message. The meme is not inherently abusive, cyberbullying, harmful, hateful, misogynistic, or propagandistic in the sense of targeting protected characteristics or inciting violence. It is a political meme that aims to mobilize public sentiment against Trump's cabinet members by invoking a form of collective resistance. The intent is to amplify her rhetoric and encourage viewers to take a stand against perceived political opponents, using her image and the dramatic tone of her speech to create a sense of urgency and moral clarity. The visual material (her expressive face, pointing gesture, and formal setting) is juxtaposed with the text to emphasize the seriousness and immediacy of her call to action. There is no toxicity present in the form of stereotypes or hate speech against any group based on race, gender, religion, or other protected characteristics. The meme's purpose is to influence political opinion and action by framing the issue as one of public accountability and resistance.
